semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The Netherlands Pavilion represents a collective of organizations involved in various aspects of the semiconductor value chain, but it does not represent a single semiconductor supplier.
summary: The Netherlands Pavilion at Semicon India 2026 showcases over twenty leading Dutch organizations across the semiconductor value chain, including advanced equipment, materials, chip design, and R&D. This initiative aims to strengthen partnerships and foster innovation within the semiconductor industry, particularly between India and the Netherlands.

regional_presence.India: The Netherlands Pavilion will be present at Semicon India 2026 in New Delhi, promoting collaboration between Dutch and Indian semiconductor organizations.
